name: Mode: Hardpoint
author: Sixth Front
description: One capture point that moves every 60 seconds between the capture points of whatever map you are playing. Whoever holds it drains the other team's tickets fast. Put it below a map mod in the list to play it on that map. The game restarts when you switch it on or off.
script: // The hardpoint visits the capture points of the map in play (a map mod above this one, or Karsa Valley)
const maps = mm.list.filter((m) => m.enabled && m.id !== api.mod.id && m.hasMap && m.mod.map && Array.isArray(m.mod.map.flags) && m.mod.map.flags.length >= 2);
const SPOTS = src.map((f) => ({ name: String(f.name || 'POINT').toUpperCase().slice(0, 20), x: Math.max(-lim, Math.min(lim, +f.x || 0)), z: Math.max(-lim, Math.min(lim, +f.z || 0)) }));
SPOTS.sort((p, q) => Math.hypot(p.x, p.z) - Math.hypot(q.x, q.z));
// Maps that rely on automatic cover lose it when their flags are replaced, so put some back
const randomCover = maps.length ? maps[maps.length - 1].mod.map.randomProps !== false : true;
api.addModel([{ shape: 'box', size: [3.2, 1, 0.9], pos: [0, 0.45, 0], color: '#a89a74', rough: 1 }],
{ x: p.x + Math.cos(a) * 9, z: p.z + Math.sin(a) * 9 }, { collide: true, rotY: (-a * 180) / Math.PI + 90, material: 'sand' });
f.x = s.x; f.z = s.z; f.y = api.heightAt(s.x, s.z); f.name = s.name;
for (const b of api.soldiers()) if (b.brain) { b.brain.moveTarget = null; b.brain.thinkT = 0; }
idx = 0; next = api.time() + PERIOD; place(0, false);
api.hud.text('hp', `HARDPOINT: ${SPOTS[idx].name}  ·  MOVES IN ${left}s`, { x: 50, y: 17, size: 0.7, color: left <= 10 ? '#ff4b3a' : '#f2b33d' });
